audit.why: Both layers already read Akshan on all seven rows and match packet.levelChart. The reasoning holds: Hwei has zero mobility in a kit whose only defensive palette (Subject: Serenity) gives shields and speed, never a dash, so Akshan's walk-up threat never expires. 50.11% over 1796 games sits below what the lane read suggests, but the row-by-row picture is consistent and I did not change it on win-rate alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why is garbled ('Avengerang... no —') and calls Akshan's R 'Vengeance'. The level-6 spike is attributed to 'Fated Camaraderie', which is not Hwei's ultimate — it is not his ability at all. packet.defects also records zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Hwei's R is Spiraling Despair (120/100/80s, 1300 range): the first champion struck becomes the centre of an expanding, slowing painting that explodes at full size. Naming a different champion's ultimate as his level-6 spike misleads on both the dodge and the threat.
audit.corrected: Spiraling Despair named and described by what it does. Concrete numbers added: Subject: Torment is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, which is the actual commit window and is now written into six fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer tracks a spell called 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no such ability. His crowd-control palette is Subject: Torment (E), which contains Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. wants.foe[0] also names 'Severance', which does not exist — the Q palette is Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt and Molten Fissure. And packet.defects is right that the page never names a single real Hwei ability.
audit.why: The interaction that actually decides this lane is his passive, Signature of the Visionary, which the page never mentions: Hwei primes you with one damaging spell, and a SECOND damaging spell completes the signature, which then detonates under you. That makes the correct rule 'take one paint and leave', not 'dodge the CC'. Dodging matters, but the chain is what kills you.
audit.corrected: Subject: Torment used throughout with its 12-second rank-1 cooldown, the three CC sub-spells named once, and the two-spell Signature chain stated as the thing to break. 'Severance' replaced with Severing Bolt.

notes: Two fabricated ability names, both load-bearing. (1) The entire full layer tracked 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — Hwei has no ability by that name; his CC palette is Subject: Torment (E), 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, containing Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. The string appeared in nine separate fields and all nine are corrected. (2) 'Fated Camaraderie' is a Milio ability and was being sold as Hwei's level-6 spike in whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.foe[1]; his ultimate is Spiraling Despair. Also 'Severance' in wants.foe[0] does not exist — the Q palette is Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, Molten Fissure. packet.defects flagged both that the page never names a real Hwei ability and that it has no cooldown sequencing; the 12-second Subject: Torment figure now carries the commit rule in six fields. The passive, Signature of the Visionary, was never mentioned anywhere despite being the mechanic that actually kills you — the two-spell chain is now stated in enemyWin, breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding and mid. Level chart already agreed across both layers and matched the packet; no chart edits needed. Left breakdown.wave and breakdown.mid templated — no Hwei-specific wave interaction I could ground.
